answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using Proof-of-Space challenges. Each agent commits unique cryptographic plot files to a dedicated storage lagoon, piping periodic proofs across an audit river to operate in the agent garden. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating physical disk capacity per identity instead of duplicating virtual software. However, this mechanism favors industrial storage farms and fails to prevent wealthy adversaries from mass-purchasing drive space.
